liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity fell by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} in undrawn committed facilities, down {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2025}}, and cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}}.

Debt due within one year was reduced by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so liquidity covers it {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}} times, down {{short_term_debt_cover.change@FY2025}} but still covering the near-term maturities without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments, the comparable measure of cash left for debt holders, fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, taking FCF after leases to debt down by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments remain large: contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} were reduced by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}}, while advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: liquidity fell by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}} and cash liquidity to revenue by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median, as excess cash was returned to shareholders.

Near-term maturities: short-term debt cover eased by {{short_term_debt_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}} as liquidity fell by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}}, leaving less headroom over the {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}} due within a year.

Cash flow after leases: FCF after leases fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}} and FCF after leases to debt by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is the highest of the network peers ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2025}}) and above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2025}}, so a larger share of liquidity is customers' money.
